packages.title: Tropical Paradise Escape
packages.subtitle: 7 Days of Sun, Sand & Culture
inclusions: Entrance fees to all listed attractions

itinerary.title: Arrival & Ubud Cultural Immersion
itinerary.description: Welcome to Bali! Transfer to Ubud, the cultural heart of the island. Afternoon visit to Ubud Palace and traditional market.

itinerary.title: Sacred Temples & Rice Terraces
itinerary.description: Full day exploring Ubud's spiritual and natural wonders.

itinerary.title: Art, Craft & Wellness
itinerary.description: Discover Ubud's artistic heritage and rejuvenate with wellness experiences.

itinerary.title: Journey to the Coast
itinerary.description: Scenic drive to Seminyak with stops at iconic landmarks.

itinerary.title: Beach Day & Shopping
itinerary.description: Relaxed day enjoying Seminyak's famous beaches and boutique shopping.
activities: Boutique shopping on Jalan Kayu Aya

itinerary.title: Free Day / Optional Tours
itinerary.description: Choose your own adventure or simply relax.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Final morning at leisure before transfer to airport.

notes: Best time to visit: April - October (dry season)
Visa on arrival available for most nationalities ($35 USD)
Local currency: Indonesian Rupiah (IDR)
Dress modestly when visiting temples (shoulders & knees covered)
Travel insurance highly recommended
packages.validity: Valid for travel: April 1 - October 31, 2025. Prices subject to change based on availability.
